nodes.description: Owner address state variable inherited from Owned; set to msg.sender at deployment and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string set to SLVC in the constructor.
Token name string set to SiliconValleyCoin in the constructor.
Token decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable (10^27) used by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Owned constructor assigning msg.sender to owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
Token constructor initializing metadata, supply and pre-funding a fixed address.
Constant view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without zeroing previous allowance.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to'; no explicit allowance sufficiency check.
Constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract before returning.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer of tokens held by the contract.
Overflow-checked addition helper from SafeMath.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper from SafeMath.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper from SafeMath.
Division helper from SafeMath guarding against division by zero.
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender used as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance key in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key when decrementing the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as the allowance key and as the from argument of receiveApproval.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state is written; enables reentrancy into approveAndCall/transferFrom.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token address, executed before state finalization.
address _newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
address to parameter of transfer.
uint tokens parameter of transfer.
address spender parameter of approve.
uint tokens parameter of approve.

address to parameter of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by the Owned constructor and assigned to the owner state variable.
The constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable, establishing the privileged account.
The onlyOwner modifier consumes msg.sender in its ownership equality check.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender inside the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable assignment.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership consumes msg.sender in the newOwner equality check.
newOwner is read by acceptOwnership to authorize the caller.
acceptOwnership moves the staged newOwner into the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the transfer.
transfer reads msg.sender as the account whose balance is debited.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] before updating them.
transfer writes the updated balances mapping for sender and recipient.
The recipient address parameter flows into the balances credit and Transfer event.
The user-supplied token amount flows into safeSub/safeAdd, where the SafeMath require guards bound the value.
transfer returns the result of safeSub applied to the sender balance.
transfer returns the result of safeAdd applied to the recipient balance.
approve uses msg.sender as the first key of the allowed mapping.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the new token amount.
The spender address parameter is used as the second key of the allowed mapping and in the event.
The tokens parameter is stored as the new allowance value.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key when decreasing the allowance.
transferFrom updates the balances of the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using safeSub.
The attacker-influenced from address determines whose balance and allowance are debited without an explicit allowance sufficiency check.
The to address parameter receives the credited tokens.
The token amount parameter feeds the safeSub/safeAdd balance arithmetic.
transferFrom uses safeSub for the balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
allowance reads the allowed mapping and returns it to the caller.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance key and passes it to receiveApproval.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before performing the external call.
The spender parameter is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and invoked, making it an attacker-controlled external callee.
The tokens parameter is stored as the allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall synchronously invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract after writing allowance state.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall before it returns.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier restricting callers to the owner.
The tokenAddress parameter is used to construct an arbitrary external contract call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded as the transfer amount of the external ERC20 call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract before returning.
The arbitrary external ERC20 transfer can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token.
The privileged owner address is passed as the destination of the external token transfer.
The constructor writes the token symbol.
The constructor writes the token name.
The constructor writes the token decimals.
The constructor sets the fixed total supply.
The constructor pre-funds the hardcoded address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply adjusted by the zero-address balance.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to compute the circulating supply.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for the queried account.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to feed the newOwner assignment inside transferOwnership.
The recipient parameter is a local input consumed exclusively by transfer.
The token amount parameter is used only in transfer's SafeMath arithmetic.
The spender parameter is local to approve's mapping write.
The tokens parameter is local to approve's allowance assignment.
The from parameter is consumed only by transferFrom balance and allowance updates.
The to parameter is consumed only by transferFrom's credit step.
The tokens parameter is consumed only by transferFrom's SafeMath arithmetic.
The spender parameter is used as the allowance key and the external callee inside approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is local to approveAndCall's allowance write and external call.
The data blob is only forwarded by approveAndCall's external call.
The tokenAddress parameter only selects the external contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter only supplies the amount for the external transfer.
